selection: HeadDev full-horizon Top1FDE strict improvement after every epoch
standardization: TRAIN630 full-horizon actor-modes only; population std; all continuous columns3:19 including base probability
distance_statistics: columns12:15 exclude actors with zero neighbors; no-neighbor distances set1 after normalization
missing_conflicts: no-neighbor conflict columns15:19 set0 after normalization; absent V/P neighbor column17/18 set0 after normalization
R1_interaction: columns12:19 exactly zero after common normalization

scientific_interpretation.severe_major_class_harm: Vehicle or Pedestrian Top1FDE increases by >=10% relative to R0 AND paired CI lower>0; descriptive operational guard set before fitting
scientific_interpretation.ReliabilityHead_SUPPORTED: at least one fixed head improves overall Top1FDE with CI upper<0, reduces OracleGap, increases HitRate, no severe class harm, geometry PASS
scientific_interpretation.ReliabilityHead_PROMISING: point improvement, smaller gap and higher HitRate with overall CI crossing0; no severe class harm and geometry PASS
scientific_interpretation.FutureInteraction_SUPPORTED: R2-R1 overall Top1FDE CI upper<0 and at least one frozen interaction group point improves; no severe class harm
scientific_interpretation.FutureInteraction_NOT_SUPPORTED: R2-R1 overall Top1FDE CI lower>0, or R2 causes severe main-class harm; otherwise WEAK
scientific_interpretation.final_variant: lowest final overall Top1FDE among R0/R1/R2 subject to geometry and severe-harm guard; descriptive selection among two prespecified heads, no VAL checkpoint selection
scientific_interpretation.PaperUsable: recommended R1/R2 lowers overall Top1FDE and OracleGap and raises HitRate without severe class harm; report supported versus promising evidence separately
